messages:
elen: FYI at 09:12 the endpoint-level p99 on /v1/respond jumped but p50/p95 fine. Merged endpoint view only.
kevin: I can repro. Splitting by region or backend removes the spike.
jonas: likely duplicates (retries/fanout) being merged as separate samples. That biases the tail when we tdigest-merge.
tara: do we have a quick way to show raw vs deduped side-by-side in the console? that would help product teams trust any change.
elen: ran an ad-hoc query to compare:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 'https://telemetry.internal/v1/metrics/aggregate?endpoint=/v1/respond&from=1749299800&to=1749300200&mode=raw' | jq .p99
# -> 1.12s
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 'https://telemetry.internal/v1/metrics/aggregate?endpoint=/v1/respond&from=1749299800&to=1749300200&mode=dedup&dedupe_by=request_id' | jq .p99
# -> 0.18s
```
kevin: big delta. Suggest console show both series (raw / deduped) stacked or adjacent and a provenance line that describes the transform.
jonas: API note: we should add `mode=(raw|tdigest|dedup)` and `dedupe_by=(none|request_id|session)` to the aggregate endpoint. Default remain raw.
tara: UX: add a small chip on the latency tile: "provenance: dedup=request_id" plus a "show raw" toggle. Also an inline estimate: "expected change: -84% p99" when delta > 20%.
elen: perf check: grouping by request_id in query adds ~10% CPU and ~90ms on 150k samples in my local run. Included bench in the PR description.
jonas: tests: add synthetic harness with duplicated high-latency samples and assert p99 collapses when dedupe active. Also document tie-breaker: pick min latency per request_id by default.
telemetry-bot: :rotating_light: alert: route=/v1/respond p99 +40% vs baseline, samples=2890
kevin: I'll draft the changelog and a small "delta report" endpoint so tenant admins can preview historical effect before default flips.
tara: I'll mock the UI for side-by-side and provenance chip, aim for a prototype by EOD.
elen: opened PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/1999 (adds dedupe mode + provenance header + console toggle). PTAL.
jonas: will add tests and perf harness + run staging canary.
kevin: ack, thanks. Let's be careful with the default in console — show raw by default until we have delta reports for large tenants.
elen: agreed, console can default to raw and show a suggested toggle recommended for merged views. We'll iterate after canary.
